production.note: Years for the whole Chiron line (500 cars including Sport, Pur Sport, Super Sport and other derivatives): hand-built in Molsheim since 2016, the 500th and last car ('L'Ultime', a Super Sport) presented May 2024. When the last base Chiron was built was not found.

body.note: Two-seat fixed-roof super sports car; the base Chiron had no open version

displacementL.note: 'Eight-litre W16'; cc figure not stated in the release

fuel.note: Petrol; duplex fuel injection with 32 injectors

powerHp.note: 1,479 hp as printed in Motor1's US spec box. Bugatti's own rating is 1,500 PS (written '1,500 HP' in its releases); 1,500 x 0.98632 = 1,479 hp. No separate SAE rating for the US was found, so powerStandard is DIN PS.

weightLb.note: 4,400 lb from Motor1's US spec box (a rounded figure; type of weight not stated, treated as curb). Bugatti's Geneva 2016 release gives no weight. Single configuration.

sources.title: Geneva International Motor Show 2016: Bugatti Chiron
'L'Ultime': celebrating the end of the incomparable Chiron era
2018 Bugatti Chiron First Drive: Record Wrecker

discrepancies.reason: Units: Bugatti's 1,500 is metric horsepower (PS); 1,479 is the same output in hp.
discrepancies.resolution: Stored 1,479 hp per the guide's PS conversion, which is also the figure US publications print.
